It reports no original data, experiment, survey or model runs; figure 2 reproduces results from the authors' earlier literature review (Perez-Blanco et al 2020), and all statements about return flows reducing water availability for other users and complicating water governance are drawn from cited work or argued conceptually. Hence Q1 is 'no' and all other questions are 'no'.
